harnessFailures.detail: The first helper incorrectly required all three GPL text members to have identical bytes and stopped before transfer. Distinct bytes and normalized comparisons were retained; installed GPL equals the installer and program member.
One generated readback helper had an IndentationError before execution; corrected helper verified actual saved bytes and then submitted a new process.
Ctrl+I was a misread of Ctrl+J and opened View Settings; cancelled without applying settings, then used actual File/Save As menu and verified saved output.
Adapted helper retained 2026-10-10 date label. Original private record retained and separate publication correction records actual 2026-10-11 operation and task timestamp.

Python3.9 rejected RFC3339 Z and nanosecond fractional timestamp forms in two helpers. Both stopped before publication record/ledger mutation; corrected Decimal fractional UTC parser preserves exact precision. Existing exported binary bytes were compared before reuse.

Initial staged diff check treated a NUL-free 64-byte output as text and reported trailing whitespace. Added an explicit .bin binary attribute; actual evidence bytes stayed unchanged, all 51 frozen index files matched and the staged diff check passed.
